name: AMD Radeon RX Vega 56
memory_bandwidth_basis: AMD product-page spec table (Wayback capture): Max. Memory Bandwidth 410 GB/s with Memory Interface 2048-bit and Memory Speed (Effective) 1.6 Gbps. 1.6 Gbps x 2048-bit / 8 = 409.6 GB/s, consistent.
notes: Cut-down Vega 10 card: 56 compute units, 3584 stream processors, 256 texture units, 12.5 billion transistors, typical board power 210 W, launched Q3 2017. All figures come from the Wayback capture of the AMD product page. The compute-performance rows of that capture were not transcribed in this pass, so flops is empty rather than derived from the Vega 64 numbers. 8 GB of HBM2 holds a 7B Q4 and not a 13B Q4. No GPU-to-GPU fabric.
